ONE LAST LITTLE SURPRISE

For the girl who
has my whole heart.

There's one more thing I want you to know. Open this when you're ready, birthday girl.

If I could teleport anywhere in the world this second, I wouldn't think twice about where I'd go.

I'd come straight to you.

I'd hold you close enough that neither of us would have to say “I miss you” for a little while.

Until that day comes, I hope this little website reminds you that the distance between us doesn't make you any less loved.

Happy birthday, my beautiful girl. You deserve all the hugs, kisses, happiness, and beautiful things this world has to offer.

And baby, when we finally get to celebrate a birthday together, I'm going to make up for every hug I couldn't give you today.

I love you. ❤️

Until I can hold you for real, here's a little piece of my heart. 💗
